changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `info_board_model_vendor_mapping` ( `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '主键ID', `model_code` varchar(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '型号编码(如A2K/A4K)', `model_name` varchar(200) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '型号名称', `platform_manufacturer` varchar(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '平台侧厂商编码(如colorlight)', `terminal_vendor_hint` varchar(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '解密网关侧厂商提示(如COLORLIGHT)', `default_port` int(11) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '默认端口号', `enabled` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 COMMENT '是否启用(1-启用/0-禁用)', `remark` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '备注', `create_time` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间', `update_time` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '更新时间', PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `uk_model_code` (`model_code`), KEY `idx_platform_manufacturer` (`platform_manufacturer`), KEY `idx_terminal_vendor_hint` (`terminal_vendor_hint`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='情报板型号-厂商映射表';
